extracted.intended_audience: public information officers, FEMA External Affairs staff, emergency management communicators at federal/tribal/state/local/private/VOAD/military partners, and others seeking PIO training
extracted.subtask_description: Catalog of FEMA and partner courses defining knowledge, skills, and competencies for Public Information Officers and external affairs staff in emergency communications, including course topics, practical exercises, and learning objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic communication skills (IS-242.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic communication skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of IS-242.a Effective Communication course designed to improve communication skills; course offered online at http://www.training.fema.gov/EMIWeb/IS/is242a.asp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicating in an emergency (IS-242.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to communicate in an emergency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-242.a covers emergency-specific communication approaches and is offered online at the FEMA EMI site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify community-specific communication issues (IS-242.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to identify community-specific communication issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Train participants to recognize and address communication needs unique to different communities (IS-242.a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Using technology as a communication tool (IS-242.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Using technology as a communication tool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-242.a includes use of technology for communication; course information available at FEMA EMI training site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective oral communication (IS-242.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective oral communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-242.a includes techniques for oral communication to improve spoken messaging and presentations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing an oral presentation (IS-242.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to prepare an oral presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-242.a provides guidance on preparing and delivering oral presentations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess communications and information management capability (IS-704)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessing the communications and information management capability of your jurisdiction or agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-704 NIMS Communications and Information Management provides capabilities required to achieve effective communications and information management; course offered online at http://www.training.fema.gov/EMIWeb/IS/IS704.asp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage incident information flow (IS-704)
rubrics_metrics.description: Managing incident information flow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-704 focuses on managing the flow of incident information among stakeholders as part of NIMS communications and information management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify strategies for continuous improvement and readiness (IS-704)
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifying strategies for continually improving communications and information management systems and maintaining their readiness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-704 emphasizes ongoing improvement and readiness of communications and information management capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply ESF 15 SOPs to external affairs (IS-250)
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic training on the concept and practical application of the ESF 15 Standard Operating Procedures to FEMA External Affairs staff and partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-250 Emergency Support Function 15 (ESF 15) External Affairs course covers ESF 15 SOPs for FEMA staff and federal/tribal/state/local/private/VOAD/military partners; offered online at http://www.training.fema.gov/EMIWeb/IS/is250.asp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand JIS and JIC roles and relationships (IS-702.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Joint Information System (JIS), and the Joint Information Center (JIC), and how they relate to each other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-702.a National Incident Management System (NIMS) Public Information Systems provides basic info and tools about JIS and JIC; course offered online at http://www.training.fema.gov/EMIWeb/IS/is702a.asp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the JIS/JIC information process (IS-702.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: The JIS/JIC process of gathering, verifying, coordinating, and disseminating information by public information and incident management personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes the procedural steps—gather, verify, coordinate, disseminate—used within the JIS/JIC to manage public information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate multiagency roles within JIS (IS-702.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each agency involved in given emergency situations and the role of each in the JIS to ensure appropriate situational awareness information is communicated to the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-702.a explains roles of agencies in multiagency incidents to ensure correct situational awareness messaging to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand key public information system terminology (IS-702.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Key terms related to public information systems to include the relationship with multiagency coordination systems and the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-702.a introduces essential terminology that links public information systems with multiagency coordination and field operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PIO role orientation (IS-29)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides an orientation to the public information function and the role of the Public Information Officer (PIO) in the public safety/emergency management environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-29 Public Information Officer Awareness Training is an awareness course covering the basics of the PIO role; offered online at http://training.fema.gov/EMIWeb/IS/is29.asp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporate lessons learned and best practices (WB1138 CERC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Shares lessons learned during public health emergencies and incorporate best practices from the fields of risk and crisis communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WB1138 Crisis & Emergency Risk Communication Course draws from real public health emergency lessons and best practices; offered online at http://www.bt.cdc.gov/cerc/ce.asp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrate emergency risk/crisis communication into operations planning (WB1138 CERC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective integration of emergency risk and crisis communication planning and resources into overall emergency operations planning at the community, state and federal levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course emphasizes embedding communication planning and resources within broader emergency operations plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply crisis communication planning and tools (WB1138 CERC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Emergency risk and crisis communication concepts, crisis communication planning and tools, including problem definition, analysis, implementation of intervention, evaluation, and feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WB1138 provides practical planning tools and a full cycle approach from problem definition through evaluation and feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Orientation to public information function and PIO role (G-289)
rubrics_metrics.description: Designed to orient the student to the public information function and the role of the public information officer in the public safety and emergency management environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: G-289 Public Information Awareness is a foundational course conducted by the states; contact your State Emergency Management Agency for offerings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure accurate and timely public information during emergencies (G-289)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring that the affected public receives accurate and timely information during an emergency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: G-289 emphasizes that accurate and timely information enables better public decisions and contributes to saving lives and protecting property.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide foundational skills/tools for new PIOs (G-289)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide participants with the skills and tools that those new to the position of PIO or with limited experience can use to effectively communicate with external audiences on a daily basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: G-289 is part of a tiered training approach providing foundation for more advanced training; conducted by states—contact State Emergency Management Agency for schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic PIO skills and knowledge (G-290)
rubrics_metrics.description: Emphasis on the basic skills and knowledge needed for emergency management public information activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: G-290 Basic Public Information Officers Course is aimed at new or less experienced PIOs and is conducted by the states; contact State Emergency Management Agency for offering details.

rubrics_metrics.name: News release writing (G-290)
rubrics_metrics.description: News release writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: G-290 includes news release writing as a topic; students will write a press release as part of the course.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public speaking and television interview skills (G-290)
rubrics_metrics.description: Public speaking and television interviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: G-290 covers public speaking and TV interview techniques; students do a videotaped practice interview and a final interview.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical exercises: press release and interview practice (G-290)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students will write a press release, do a video-taped practice interview and final interview.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hands-on exercises are part of G-290 to build applied skills in writing and on-camera communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal issues in public information (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal Issues in Public Information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E388 Advanced Public Information Officer is a four-day course with lectures and exercises; conducted at the Emergency Management Institute in Emmitsburg, Md.; details at http://training.fema.gov/emicourses/crsdetail.asp?cid=E388&ctype=R.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public information and public policy (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Public Information and Public Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advanced PIO course includes how public information intersects with public policy as a course topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk communication (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Risk Communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E388 covers risk communication concepts and practice as part of advanced training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpersonal skills for PIOs (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpersonal Skills for Public Information Officers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course includes development of interpersonal skills needed for PIO work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict resolution (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conflict Resolution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E388 includes instruction and exercises on resolving conflicts relevant to public information work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicating effectively during an emergency (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Communicating Effectively During an Emergency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advanced-level guidance and exercises on emergency-specific communication challenges are included in E388.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media relations (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Media Relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course focuses on building and managing relationships with media outlets as part of PIO responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emergency information systems (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Emergency Information Systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E388 addresses the systems used to manage and disseminate emergency information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stress management for PIOs (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stress Management for PIOs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advanced course includes strategies for managing stress encountered in PIO roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint Information Center exercise (E388)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Joint Information Center exercise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E388 includes a JIC exercise to practice coordination and information management in a simulated joint information environment.
